title: Freelance Writer Invoice Template: Per Word, Hour or Project
description: Bill writing work per word, per hour or per project from your browser. No sign-up. PDF, Word, Excel, with 2026 EFA rate ranges and rights wording.
lede_html: Fill in the form to bill an article, a blog series or an hourly job, and download a PDF, Word or Excel file. No account. The sample is two articles per word. Change it to your work.

must_show.heading: What a freelance writing invoice must show
must_show.intro_html: The invoice shows the work by word count or hours, the rights that pass, the due date and how to pay. Accounts payable often needs a PO number before it pays.
must_show.why_label: Why it matters on writing work

line_items.heading: Writing rates from the 2026 EFA chart
line_items.intro_html: Tap Add to put a line on the form. The range comes from the source in the same row, and the button adds a sample inside it. The Editorial Freelancers Association chart shows median rate ranges from a survey of its members.

rules.heading: Rights and tax rules for writers

items.title: Copyright transfer
items.html: Under 17 U.S.C. 204, a transfer of copyright is not valid unless it is in writing and signed by the owner or the owner's agent. An invoice that you sign can be evidence, but your contract should hold the transfer.

items.title: Work made for hire
items.html: 17 U.S.C. 101 limits this to employees and to commissioned works in listed categories with a signed written agreement. Ask a lawyer before you write work for hire on an invoice.

items.title: Form 1099-NEC
items.html: The IRS instructions call for reporting nonemployee compensation of $2,000 or more. Check the instructions for the tax year. Keep your own invoices for every client below that amount, too.

faq.q: Do I bill the word count I wrote or the published count?
faq.a: Use the count in your contract. If it says nothing, use the delivered count and state it on the line.

faq.q: How do I write a per-word rate on the form?
faq.a: Enter the word count as the quantity, word as the unit and the rate in dollars, such as 0.25. The total calculates by itself.

faq.q: When do I add a kill fee?
faq.a: When the client stops a piece after you started and your contract has a kill fee. Add it as its own line with the article title.

faq.q: Can I bill for research time?
faq.a: If you agreed to it. Show research hours on a separate line, or include them in your per-word or project price.
